title: Equidimensional fibre pieces of a fibre Cohen-Macaulay open
statement: Let f:X→T be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], U an open of T, with f restricted over U flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Let W be an open of X such that for every y in W, f(y) is in U and the depth [def-weil-pbc-depth] of the local ring of the fibre X_{f(y)} at y [def-pc-scheme-fibre; def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] equals its ring Krull dimension [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. There are opens $V_n\subseteq X$ whose union is $W$, pairwise disjoint, such that for every $n\in\mathbb N$, $t\in T$ and every irreducible component $C$ [def-weil-irreducible-components] of the open subspace $(X_t\to X)^{-1}(V_n)$, the topological Krull dimension [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension] of $C$ is $n$.

proof.text: Restrict the base to U and source to W. The inclusion f(W) ⊆ U follows from hW. Open restrictions preserve flatness and local finite presentation. The restriction pullback squares identify fibre stalks with original fibre stalks. The fibres are locally Noetherian by lem-sbc-restricted-fibre-locally-noetherian. Ring isomorphisms preserve depth and Krull dimension, so the restricted fibres are Cohen-Macaulay. Apply Stacks 02NM to W → U, obtaining disjoint clopen subschemes W_n with pure relative dimension n in the sense of 02NJ. Map these into X. Their fibre spaces identify with the inverse images of V_n in X_t. Homeomorphisms identify components and preserve dimension. Empty W and empty fibres cause no exception. This isolates the geometric decomposition; it makes no assertion about local dimension at a point.

theorem exists_equidimensional_fibre_open_partition_of_depth_eq_ringKrullDim
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ T) (U : T.Opens)
    [Flat (f ∣_ U)] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation (f ∣_ U)] (W : X.Opens)
    (hW : ∀ y ∈ W, f y ∈ U ∧
      (IsLocalRing.depth (R := (f.fiber (f y)).presheaf.stalk (f.asFiber y))
        ((f.fiber (f y)).presheaf.stalk (f.asFiber y)) : WithBot ℕ∞) =
          ringKrullDim ((f.fiber (f y)).presheaf.stalk (f.asFiber y))) :
    ∃ V : ℕ → X.Opens, (⨆ n, V n) = W ∧
      Pairwise (fun m n => Disjoint (V m) (V n)) ∧
      ∀ n t, ∀ C ∈ irreducibleComponents
        ↥((f.fiberι t) ⁻¹ᵁ V n), topologicalKrullDim C = (n : WithBot ℕ∞)
